title: Owner-Authorized Private Audio Binary Read
goal: Allow an authenticated project owner to retrieve private WAV bytes through a server-only Sesh API without exposing private storage authority.

route.authorization: existing owner-authorized private audio item read

sequence: validate canonical project and audio identifiers
perform existing owner-authorized sanitized audio item read
reload canonical private audio metadata server-side
verify project and audio identity agree with the authorized read
require a private storage reference and audio/wav content type
read private bytes from injected Sesh audio object store
return copied bytes without exposing storage metadata
